method: Three separate Linux release processes per source-backed input/profile; 100 parses and full constructors timed separately (ownership passed, no parsing/clone in prepare timer); 100 THING batches timed after construction for typed profiles only; 1000 immutable collision and sight queries; 100 direct Chase calls each on fresh same-input targets for typed profiles only; 100 script updates including external scripted damage and Snapshot construction, then 100 complete canonical encodings. Native wait4 RSS includes benchmark/Rust allocator/event overhead, not Python launch pages. Profile17 prepared metrics unavailable (null); profile19 has no typed batch/Chase (zero timer is not claimed execution). Only small_control17/20 are like-for-like gameplay inputs; other sizes/profiles are different workloads. No performance threshold or universal regression claim
